findings.finding: Do not accept the proposed second-takedown production fix on the submitted evidence. The Down injection bypasses Seize, which already cancels every pending report for the seized person, without a woken exception.
findings.evidence: N56 orders with only the final retreat omitted: wake at 3660; issue accepted knockout or kill at 3661; original report due 3730 immediately becomes stopped, original ActTrail remains false, Acts.Count=2. Both runs have zero refused orders, equal replay checkpoints and equal full state hashes. No public-state injection.
findings.limitation: This refutes the claimed pre-deadline second-takedown gap in the exercised route; it does not prove the woken exemption safe for every incapacitation path. GuardHit/CivilianHit directly set Down without Seize. An attempted fire order at guard 73 was refused target-unknown, so no shooting defect is claimed. Exact landing-tick ties and all other victim types were not tested.

findings.finding: All submitted totals use the formula correctly, but none of the claimed direct dependents has a demonstrated prerequisite edge to distinct pending work. Silent-takedown interruption and Trail/dispatch correctness are benefits of the same fix. Closing-event correctness restates its task. Campaign code can consume the existing Between data; the proposed Start case-count slice does not require JSON export. Escalation and its tests are part of the carry-forward task. Set all four dependency bonuses to zero for this selection.

N47 produces one typed missing case and one typed area watch. Debrief.Write exports neither structured collection, while prose and aggregates already exist. The data loss at the writer boundary is real; treating structured JSON as desired output is an engineering interpretation, not a new literal GDD mandate.
findings.evidence: N47 27/27 checks pass; Cases.Count=1, AreaWatch.Count=1; serialized JSON has neither cases nor areaWatch key.

recommendation.title: Serialize existing case and area-watch consequences in the headless debrief
recommendation.acceptanceScope: Accept this bounded export selection; reject the claim that a second-takedown fix is presently justified. Implementation remains a separate handoff.
recommendation.contract: Add nextMission.cases entries {who,kind,place,missions} and nextMission.areaWatch entries {place,guards,cameras,missions} from existing tuples in their existing order. Omit each empty collection to preserve empty-case output. Preserve current who role/id convention, coordinate-string place values, -1 missing-case lifetime, aggregate fields and prose. No new block mapping, campaign progression or consequence calculation.
risks: Existing who values mix role aliases and person IDs; export faithfully and document this, do not imply stable campaign identity.
place is a scene coordinate string, not a block ID; export cannot claim generated block guard/camera placement.
Prose already exposes the consequences, so value is structured integration fidelity, not a wholly missing debrief feature.
Additive keys may affect strict downstream JSON consumers; inspect consumers and preserve existing fields and empty output.
acceptanceTests: N47 missing-person fixture: parse serialized debrief; verify one guard missing case, existing scene place, missions=-1, watch +1 guard/+1 camera for 3 missions; check tuples are preserved and retain aggregate/prose compatibility.
Use an existing order-driven found-killing fixture; assert found-killing lifetime from the rulebook and matching scene/watch data, with expected values independent of writer output.
No-case successful debrief: no new empty fields under the proposed contract; existing FailCauseTests remain passing.
Repeated Debrief.Of/Write yields deterministic JSON and leaves full simulation state hashes/checkpoints unchanged. Selected scenario replays stay identical.
Run focused C# tests for changed serializer and chosen scenarios; record any unrelated pre-existing suite failure separately.
recommendation.explicitLimitation: This completes a serialization boundary only. It does not implement campaign persistence, case aging/closure, next-mission security input, block identification or guard/camera placement; it is not complete GDD coverage or a completed revised goals-agent live demonstration.
